name: San Jose Middle College (San Jose City College)
org: San Jose Unified School District with San Jose City College
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take 2 to 3 free college classes plus 4 high school classes on the San Jose City College campus and earn a diploma plus transferable credit.
who_can_apply: Juniors and seniors. Application needs administrator and teacher recommendations, parent and student questionnaires and an unofficial transcript. Whether students outside San Jose Unified can apply is not stated on the page I read.
pay_detail: Free college classes (6 to 9 college credits)
deadline_text: No deadline shown on the SJCC page. The application steps are on the SJUSD Middle College site, which I could not open.
how_to_apply: Submit the application packet (recommendations, parent and student questionnaires, transcript) to the Middle College office in Business Building B-107, or follow the SJUSD application portal.
notes: Could not confirm the deadline, selection rules or whether students outside San Jose Unified can apply: the SJUSD application page linked from the SJCC page returned an error. Contact Lisa Canton, lcanton@sjusd.org, 408-298-2191 ext. 3996.
